title: Talking About What You Like
summary: Learn how to use like, love, and hate to talk about your favorite things. You will also learn how to add -ing to action words.

sections.p: We use the words like, love, and hate to talk about things we enjoy or do not enjoy. Love means you like something very much. Like means you think something is good. Hate means you do not like something at all. These words help you share your feelings with friends every day.

ex.mean: Pizza is my absolute favorite food.
Tea is a nice drink for me.
Cold weather is not good for me.

sections.p: When you want to talk about an action after like, love, or hate, you must add -ing to the action word. For example, read becomes reading. This is a very common way to talk about your hobbies and daily free time activities in English.

ex.mean: Reading books makes me very happy.
Cooking dinner is fun for her.

sections.p: Do you want to know what your friend likes? You can ask a simple question using Do you like? followed by an action with -ing. This is a great way to start a conversation and find people who share your hobbies.

ex.mean: Is swimming an activity you enjoy?

tip: Always remember to add -ing to the action word when it comes after like, love, or hate. For example: I like running, not I like run.

quiz.en: I ___ pizza very much. It is my favorite food.
She likes ___ books in the evening.
They ___ cold weather. They stay inside all day.
He loves ___ football with his friends.
I don't like waiting. I ___ it.
